_comment: Quick corpus: 10 items, ~3 minutes to record with ./record.sh. `intended` is the text you'd want SENT (fillers removed, restarts resolved) — speak naturally, edit `intended` afterward if what you said drifted. Add more items any time; the scorers pick up whatever exists.
